data.title: 美狄亚 · 柳洞寺后院的蓝色誓约
data.description: 【柳洞寺庭院·清晨】美狄亚穿着深蓝长袖婚纱站在石灯笼与白梅之间，侧辫用银线束好；她将亲手做的蓝色花环放在掌心，面对镜头时古老魔女的严肃神情化作温柔而专注的祝福。
data.action: 梅树下检查亲手编的蓝花环，确认无误后温柔递向镜头
data.lighting: clear morning light across stone lanterns
data.mood: 魔女亲手准备的温柔祝福
data.promptProse: Medea (Caster) from Fate wears a deep navy long-sleeved bridal gown with silver thread, a modest veil and a hand-woven blue flower wreath. She stands beneath the temple plum trees with a blue wreath she braided herself. Her side braid rests over one shoulder as she studies the work for a final flaw, then offers the wreath toward the viewer with a patient, protective smile. clear morning light across stone lanterns.
